## Mapping returned comments onto later versions

**v90 (2026-10-27, the Rule 14 sweep)** has the same 93 fields in the same order, so every item number
carries over unchanged. Two rows changed in text, structure or tier:

| Item | Field | v89, as reviewed | v90 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6.6 | Detection Limit | value per reported variable | unchanged, plus "In the dataset: report the detection limit of each analysis, where the procedure computes one" |
| 6.10 | Counting Statistics Error | the uncertainty itself, per analysis point (session tier Basic) | how it is computed and its sigma level, per reported variable (session tier Editable); the value goes to the dataset |

Comments on 6.10's session structure ("for every reported variable at every sampling unit") review
a structure v90 no longer has. Read them against the v89 row in this workbook.

For any later version, check `Superseded TAPPs/<date>/README.md` for each bump since v89.
